annotations.title: Resolve or create a MuseScore score PDF

description: Resolve or create a PDF for a MuseScore score. If the score exposes an official PDF download and is free (is_free) or accessible (hasAccess), downloads the official PDF bytes to output_path (written: true, bytes, outputPath). Otherwise (incl. paid scores, or when the official download fails) fetches the page-1 render SVG — the score’s public thumbnail — and stitches it into output_path. The score is identified by a url (a musescore.com score URL or /user/<id>/scores/<id> path) or a user_id + score_id pair. Requires a signed-in MuseScore session. In mode "official", a view-free but Premium/purchase-gated download returns a structured {status:"gated", requiresPurchase, downloadUrl, scoreUrl, svgStitchAvailable} result rather than erroring.

dpi.description: Deprecated/ignored — SVG-stitch conversion is now vector (no rasterisation).

mode.description: auto (default): the 3-tier fallback chain — official PDF (if entitled) → SVG-stitch PDF → PNG render → structured "gated". The result reports which tier won via `via` (official_pdf | svg_pdf | png_render | gated) and, for renders, pagesRendered/pagesTotal/truncated. official: official PDF only (gated → structured gated). svg: page-1 SVG stitched to a PDF. png: page-1 PNG render written as a .png (for scores rendered as PNG but not SVG). render tiers cover page 1; truncated:true means pages 2+ are gated (use official/auto for the full document).

output_path.description: Local .pdf path to write. Parent directories are created. Must be inside MUSESCORE_OUTPUT_DIR (default ~/Downloads); a relative path is resolved against it. An existing file is never overwritten — a numbered sibling (e.g. score-2.pdf) is written instead and returned as outputPath.

pages.description: 1-based page numbers for SVG-stitch mode. Only page 1 is available locally (pages 2+ are gated); requesting any other page errors. Ignored when an official PDF is downloaded. Defaults to page 1.

url.description: A musescore.com score URL or /user/<id>/scores/<id> path. Provide this OR user_id + score_id.
